Saved Views is available today for every customer on a paid plan. If you've ever rebuilt the same filters and sort order each morning, this feature is for you. Now you can capture any combination of filters, grouping, and sorting as a named view you return to with a single click, instead of recreating it from scratch each time.

Every user can save up to 50 views, so there's plenty of room for personal dashboards, sprint boards, client lists, or anything else you check often. Views aren't just for you, either: share any saved view with your team so everyone works from the same setup, whether that's a weekly status board or a bug triage queue. Shared views update automatically as the underlying data changes, keeping everyone aligned without extra effort.

Saved Views is included at no additional cost across all paid plans, so there's nothing to enable or upgrade. It's simply there, ready when you are.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
